$comment: Completion bar for #117: MediaChatView appended origin=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com to the embed URL; the IFrame API uses origin as the postMessage target for the embedding page, which is file:// in production, so onReady/onStateChange never fired and seek/follow-playhead did nothing. Research (production build, CDP, file:// renderer, with #116 fixed): with origin= the player never became ready; without it onReady fired, seekTo(30) worked (getCurrentTime ~35s) and no player error (incl. 153) occurred, because the main-process Referer/Origin rewrite already covers #24. Fix: drop origin=. Criterion 1 is behavioral and fails before the change: a renderer test ingests a YouTube URL and asserts the mounted iframe src equals the IPC embed URL with no origin param. 2-3 guard typecheck and build.
